title: A Calculator With Parentheses

concept.title: A minus sign in front of a parenthesis flips everything inside
body: The expression contains numbers, `+`, `-`, spaces and parentheses. There is no multiplication, so there is no precedence to handle; the only difficulty is the parentheses: `10 - (2 + 3)` is `10 - 2 - 3`, because the sign before the parenthesis applies to **all** the terms inside.

Process the characters from left to right and keep `result` (the value of the part read so far in the current level), `sign` (the sign of the next number, +1 or -1) and `num` (the number that is being read). On a **`(`**, push the pair `(result, sign)` on the stack and start a new level with `result = 0` and `sign = 1`. On a **`)`**, finish the number, pop `(prev_result, prev_sign)` and set `result = prev_result + prev_sign * result`.
A minus can also stand at the start of the expression or right after a `(` (for example `-(2+3)` or `(-4)`): the code handles this, because the number before it is just 0. Spaces are skipped.

statement: Evaluate an expression that has non-negative integers, the operators `+` and `-`, parentheses and spaces. A `-` may also appear at the start of the expression or directly after `(`, as a sign of the number or of the parenthesis that follows. Print the value.
inputFormat: One line with the expression. It is always valid. Two operators never follow each other directly (`--` does not occur).
outputFormat: Print the value of the expression.
constraints: Each number is at most 10^6, and every partial value fits in 64 bits.

examples.note: The minus applies to the whole parenthesis: 10 - 5 = 5.

hints: Without multiplication, the only thing that matters is the sign in front of each number.
When you meet `(`, save the result so far and the sign before the parenthesis on a stack.
On `)`, combine the saved result with the value of the parenthesis, using the saved sign.

explanation: The result and the sign before a parenthesis are saved on a stack at `(` and combined with the value of the parenthesis at `)`. Between them, numbers are added with their signs.
solution.complexity: Time O(n), space O(depth of the parentheses).

code.python:
s = input()

result = 0
sign = 1
num = 0
stack = []
for ch in s:
    if "0" <= ch <= "9":
        num = num * 10 + int(ch)
    elif ch == "+" or ch == "-":
        result += sign * num
        num = 0
        sign = 1 if ch == "+" else -1
    elif ch == "(":
        stack.append((result, sign))
        result = 0
        sign = 1
    elif ch == ")":
        result += sign * num
        num = 0
        prev_result, prev_sign = stack.pop()
        result = prev_result + prev_sign * result
result += sign * num
print(result)
